subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack and Discord workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, scopes, requester authorization, and gateway permission boundary should it require?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but channel creation lets agents mutate provider-side workspace/server structure; current main has partial Discord support and no Slack gate or runtime, so automation should not choose the authority model by itself.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack `channel-create`, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Land or replace PR #65065 for Discord's existing provider support while leaving Slack and the broader admin model tracked separately.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep channel provisioning in Slack/Discord admin tools or external scripts until stronger demand justifies a native agent authority surface.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack `channel-create`, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has already reviewed this exact issue surface and has recent history across the CLI, Slack, Discord, and docs paths involved in the decision.
